title: System Context View
summary: Who owns the source-stated work in Harbor Desk.
read_guide: People are source-stated participants, not necessarily product users. First-run performers connect to their selected source events. Other named participants remain context only. Human and external-system action groups connect to the candidate product through a non-owning first-path interaction boundary; dotted participant-context links assign no action. The first-run view shows one proposed walkthrough, not source-list chronology. Registry links identify proposed support, not replacement of source ownership.
